# SCI-FLT-MATCHED v0.1 — Author Supersession And Exclusion Cover

Status: sanitized author input; owner approval and Stage B launch pending

## Program Adherence And Prior-Work Recovery

Recovered science enters authorship only through this manifest-bound packet.

## Superseded Scientific Identity

The historical full Citlali path sometimes called the “Wiener filter” is
scientifically treated here as an **optimal matched-template amplitude
estimator**. The historical name may remain only as compatibility terminology.
It supplies no sky-signal prior, posterior-sky estimand, or authority for a
posterior/Wiener reconstruction.

Convolution with a source-shaped kernel alone is not the same operation: it
lacks the declared noise weighting and amplitude-unbiased matched-estimator
normalization. `SCI-FLT-FIXED` remains a separate protected package.

## Withheld Material

The author shall not inspect historical mechanics, implementation, config,
schemas, tests, audits, repairs, validation, reductions, generated products,
defaults, production status, the holding-study dossier, or unlisted sources.
The owner-provided fact that a radially symmetrized average map noise PSD has
been used historically is admitted only in the option assignment. It does not
carry its population, ordering, Fourier convention, normalization, window,
edge, coefficient, threshold, or numerical rules.

## Deferred Families

The packet excludes posterior/Wiener sky reconstruction, source detection and
catalog behavior, source- or candidate-learned templates, data-thresholded
destriping, automatic selectors/fallbacks, adaptive edge/background methods,
the historical high-pass/delta case, and FRUIT algorithms. Each requires a
separate scientific contract if later commissioned.
